verdict.rationale: The pack never documents issuing refunds from the point of sale, the dashboard, or the API. It also says nothing about full versus partial amounts or returning funds to the original card. The only refund-related item describes webhook notifications of refund updates, which is an adjacent notification feature and does not show the issuing capability itself.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can issue full or partial refunds back to the original card from the point of sale, dashboard, or API
